name: Applied Intuition
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Applied Intuition is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Applied Intuition is a privately held vehicle software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a Series F round announced on June 17, 2025, valued the company at $15 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in Mountain View, California, Applied Intuition develops autonomy software, vehicle operating systems and development tools for automakers and for trucking, defense, mining, construction and agriculture customers. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Series F financing, including a tender offer
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except the Series C figure, which is as reported at the time. The Series F amount includes a tender offer for existing shares.
round_notes: With the Series F announcement, Applied Intuition said that 18 of the top 20 global automakers used its products; that figure is the company's own. In November 2026, Bloomberg reported that the company was in talks to raise $1.5 billion in a round led by General Catalyst, at a valuation of $30 billion. Applied Intuition has not announced the round.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: BlackRock-managed funds and Kleiner Perkins co-led the Series F, with new investors including Franklin Templeton, Qatar Investment Authority, Abu Dhabi Investment Council and Premji Invest. Lux Capital and Elad Gil led the Series E, in which Porsche Investments Management joined as a strategic investor, and Elad Gil, Addition and Coatue Management co-led the Series D. Other investors include Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, BOND and Fidelity Management & Research Company.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show two special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Applied Intuition, both organized in 2026.
funds: Mutual funds and other SEC-registered funds managed by Fidelity reported Applied Intuition holdings in filings for periods in 2026. Fidelity Blue Chip Growth Fund valued its position at $11.2 million as of January 31, 2026.
sources: Sources: Applied Intuition's announcements of its Series F, Series E, Series D and Series C; reports by Bloomberg (November 2026) and Global Venturing (October 2020); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
